The user wants a Rust array expression containing specific SlotValue variants. They want it fully qualified with vb_core:: prefixes. Let me construct this carefully.

The variants are:
- Null
- Bool(false)
- Bool(true)
- I64(i64::MIN)
- I64(i64::MAX)
- F64(vb_core::value::FiniteF64::new(1.25)?)
- Symbol(vb_core::SymbolId::new(0))
- List(vb_core::ListId::new(0))
- Object(vb_core::ObjectId::new(0))
- Blob(vb_core::BlobId::new(0))

All need to be wrapped in vb_core::SlotValue:: prefix. The array should be [vb_core::SlotValue::Null, vb_core::SlotValue::Bool(false), ...].

The user said "Output ONLY a Rust array expression" and "No code beyond array." So just the array literal.
